notes:
Single source of truth for domain-related placeholders. When the official domain is purchased,
run the appropriate scripts to replace all tokens consistently. Do NOT edit these values to invent
a domain — the real domain must come from the pemilik produk after registrar verification.

After domain is set, recommended replacement commands:
  node scripts/replace-domain.mjs  (will replace all tokens in landing files, package.json, electron-builder.yml)
  npm run landing:check:strict   (should then exit 0)
  npm run proxy:check -- --strict  (should then exit 0)
